Lo uso per il cane e gli piace stare dentro sono felice.
Awesome for men made pizza at home. Game changer for a well baked crust.

Prior to this we were baking our pizzas in a cookie sheet. They were good but not quite the same texture as the pizzaria. Ever since we started using the pizza steel we're able to use much higher oven temperature (550 F). Our pizzas are baked within 3 minutes and are delicious.
Très efficace, la chaleur que dégage cette plaque de 3/8 po d’épais améliore de beaucoup la cuisson des pains, pizza, tartes etc
This is an excellent pizza steel! I use it in the oven for bread and pizza, pita bread. Good value! Thicker than other brands, retains heat very well!

This steel is thick and good size for price compared to other vendors. I did the initial seasoning and has been easy non stick since. I coat my pizza dough with corn meal on bottom and slides easily on it. Crank the oven up to 550F and let it heat for 1/2 to hour and then put pizza in, wait about 15 min or so until toppings and crust are browned to desired color, the pizza comes out great, I would say as good as restaurant quality. I've baked sourdough loafs directly on it as well, and loafs come out nice and not burned on bottoms.
Seem like quality items they are just too damn heavy to be practical. Get yourself the 1/4 and don’t worry about the risk of dropping these and causing catastrophic damage to whatever they land on.

"pre-Seasoned" should read coated. I was hoping for a Seasoned Plate Steel Pizza Steel. This seems to have some Black non-stick type coating on it. While I feel this coating will eventually fail, I think I can still Season it like raw steel. All being said however for the price I don't think it can be beat. I am not dissapointed in my purchase however perhaps my expectations were to high. The packaging it came in also could be improved. It is very heavy and a corner of the package was ripped causing some of the aforementioned black coating to chip off..

Nice little pool cleaning kit for a great price. Quality is good, the brushes have good stiff bristles and the nets are well made. I especially like the curved lips on the front of the nets that help scoop up debris from the pool bottom. I use these with the Vevor extending pool pole and they fit perfectly. Makes pool cleaning quick and easy.
Very robust compared with similar items flimsy provided by most pool stores and major retailers. Excellent and will last for many years.

Ho acquistato queste teche, prezzo onesto, spedizione veloce, imballato con cura, ne ho presi 4, contengono tutte chiavi di sicurezza e viti per appendere al muro se necessario, io li userò per vendere le mie carte nelle fiere, molto comodo

Was worried about overall quality when I opened the box…. BUT I was pleasantly surprised to see how it all came together!! Heavy, Super sturdy, and worth the cost! The cloth and cardboard drawers concerned me… BUT they are strong and will hold A LOT! This is a game changer for Cricut users! Saves time from having to dig thru bins seeking vinyl or mats or tools! Saves money because you don’t reorder things you already have because you can’t find them! I LOVE this cart and the wheels are the best part so I can use it and roll it away when I’m done! Instructions were easy to follow. I haven’t loaded supplies in it yet… because I have to locate them all LOLOL This is going to make my life so much easier!!
Bought it for my girlfriend and she's stoked about it. Finish and quality is excellent
